capabilities: Save node positions in the graph view
Restore saved node positions via command
Automatically restore positions when a graph view opens
extras: The README warns the plugin uses internal Obsidian APIs and may break with updates, and that it is unlikely to be accepted as a community plugin. The project is seeking a new maintainer because the author cannot fix outstanding issues. It also warns the plugin may not survive Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: adds commands to save and restore the locations of nodes on your graph
motivation: The author considered persistent graph layouts so important that he built the plugin himself despite it using internal APIs.
problem: Obsidian resets all node positions in the graph view on restart, so a carefully arranged graph layout is lost every session.
summary: Plugin that saves and restores node positions in the graph view so your graph layout persists across Obsidian restarts.
